cd /workspace/tmp && cat > t_stress1.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc

NS = 512          # string maxsize
NPAR = 4          # 4 string params -> 4*(1+NS) ids, 4*NS = 2048 slots
RUNS = 1000
campaign = {
  "types": [{"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": NS},
            {"name": "Q", "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b", "c"]}],
  "modules": [{"name": "big", "params": [["p%d" % i, "S"] for i in range(NPAR)] + [["q", "Q"]],
               "result": ["out", "Q"], "requires": None}],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["big"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
runs = []
for r in range(RUNS):
    objs = []
    slot = 0
    for i in range(NPAR):
        slot += 1                      # buffer id
        text = chr(97 + (r % 3)) * NS
        for j in range(NS):
            objs.append(("x%d" % (slot + j), enc(ord(text[j]) if j < NS else 0, 1)))
        slot += NS
    objs.append(("x%d" % slot, enc(r % 3, 4)))
    slot += 1
    objs.append(("x%d" % slot, enc((r // 3) % 3, 4)))
    runs.append({"entry": "big", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign["runs"] = runs
data = json.dumps(campaign)
sys.stderr.write('input bytes: %d, slots: %d, objects: %d\n' % (len(data), NPAR * NS, RUNS * (NPAR * NS + 2)))
sys.stdout.write(data)
PYEOF
python3 t_stress1.py > tests/stress1.json && time python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < tests/stress1.json > /tmp/s1.out && python3 -c "
import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/s1.out'))
print(len(d['plans'][0]['slots']), d['plans'][0]['variables'], len(d['records']), len(d['corpus']))
print(d['records'][:3])"
